raw_message.reasoning:
The issue is that `kwonly_defaults` (which is `func.__kwdefaults__`) contains all keyword-only args with their defaults. For a function like `def f(a, *, b, c=10)`, `__kwdefaults__` would be `{'c': 10}` - it doesn't include `b` since `b` has no default. So the loop only sees `c`, and since `c` has a value in `kwonly_defaults`, it doesn't count it.
